_what: Task V32, the far kart. materials: colour palette of the far kart body; cell i of a grid x grid palette holds the look of material i. make_kart_lod.py (Blender) points every face of the far body at its cell; NovaKartVisualBuilder (Unity) paints the cells from the real kart materials, so colours always match. NK_Paint_Body is not in the palette: it stays its own material, so BotKartPaint can still recolour the far kart. tyre_bake: the far tyre is baked; every full-tyre material glows in its ID colour in the ID map, and Unity swaps each ID colour for that material's real colour and metal values.
